property: Every mix of verdict, judge, review, rounds, reasons, checks, screen sizes, asks, work, next asks, steps and url that the model lists is a run the final message can be built from, with no crash, no undefined and no NaN
When one piece of a run changes, the message built from the new run shows the change, and is built from the new run and not from the old one
After one piece of a run changes, every line of the message that is not about that piece reads exactly as it did

In every mix the verdict is alone on line 1 and the reason is line 2, the pitch is left to the report, every label appears once when its data exists and not otherwise, steps and reasons take one line each, the blocks come in order with one blank line between them, no fact is lost, no line ends in a space and the same run gives the same message
From every state of the model there is a next change or the state is a named stop, so the search ends having seen every mix (no deadlock). No fairness is assumed
A line break or a run of spaces inside a value adds no line to the message and changes no word of it
Building the message leaves the run it was given exactly as it was
The same run with its keys in another order gives the same message
A message built after another run's message shows only its own run: nothing is left behind between calls
A list of next asks or of reasons longer than three shows three and says how many more are in the report, and a list of three or fewer says nothing about more
A control code in a value (a clear screen code, a bell, a null byte) never reaches the message, and the words around it stay
A blank step beside real ones takes no number, and the steps count up one by one with no gap
The message is byte for byte the same under another language and another time zone
A message never runs past 30 lines, which is what a run with four steps, two checks, three reasons and every other line full adds up to
100x finish refuses a run with more than four try-first steps, so the list in the message cannot grow past what the owner reads on one screen
command: X100_FAST=1 node --test --test-name-pattern="finish refuses too many try-first steps" test/finish.test.mjs
